extracted.intended_audience: prospective Knight-Hennessy Scholars applicants (and applicants to Stanford graduate programs)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines describing how Knight-Hennessy Scholars (KHS) and Stanford graduate degree programs evaluate applicants: lists KHS selection criteria, program-specific criteria, required application components, reviewers' responsibilities, and timelines/notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence of thought
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the Knight-Hennessy Scholars selection criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a core evaluative dimension for KHS selection; no additional elaboration on the page beyond inclusion in the Selection Criteria list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purposeful leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the Knight-Hennessy Scholars selection criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a core evaluative dimension for KHS selection; no additional elaboration on the page beyond inclusion in the Selection Criteria list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civic mindset
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the Knight-Hennessy Scholars selection criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a core evaluative dimension for KHS selection; no additional elaboration on the page beyond inclusion in the Selection Criteria list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program-specific selection criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Some selection criteria vary by Stanford graduate program (noted as 'Varies by program').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are instructed to consult their graduate degree program directly for program-specific criteria; examples/requirements may differ across departments and are evaluated by the degree program's admission committee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate, concurrent reviews by KHS and Stanford degree programs
rubrics_metrics.description: KHS and the applicant's Stanford degree program(s) evaluate applications concurrently but separately; separate admission committees make independent assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application materials are not shared between the committees except in very rare cases when it may aid evaluation. KHS does not review the Stanford degree program application(s) but checks periodically with programs to verify which applicants have applied and remain competitive for admission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admission committee responsibilities (who reviews which aspects)
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarifies which committee reviews KHS criteria versus program-specific criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: KHS Admission Committee reviews KHS selection criteria (independence of thought, purposeful leadership, civic mindset). Admission committee for the desired Stanford graduate program reviews program-specific criteria. The committees make independent admissions determinations and normally do not share materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to submit both KHS and Stanford graduate program applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must complete both the Knight-Hennessy Scholars application AND the entire application process for their Stanford graduate degree program(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The graduate program application(s) may include standardized tests (GMAT, GRE, LSAT, MCAT, etc.) and, if applicable, English proficiency tests (TOEFL, IELTS; for MBA only, PTE). Graduate program applications may require fees. Applicants should visit the specific graduate program pages for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Must have an offer of admission from a Stanford graduate program to be a KHS
rubrics_metrics.description: You cannot be admitted to Knight-Hennessy Scholars without first receiving an offer of admission from a Stanford graduate degree program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: KHS explicitly states 'KHS cannot admit you to Stanford!' They check with degree programs at regular intervals and advance only those KHS applicants whom the degree program verifies are eligible/competitive. If an applicant is admitted to the degree program but not selected for KHS, they may still enroll at Stanford.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional application components and evaluation stages
rubrics_metrics.description: There are invitation-only and scheduled components of the KHS evaluation process that may be required for finalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Components include a video statement (invitation only), the Finalist Experience (invitation only), an online individual interview in mid-February 2027, and an Immersion Weekend (March 5-6, 2027). These are additional evaluation touchpoints for invited applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification and timeline expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: The page specifies when invitations and decisions are communicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Video statement invitations are sent on a rolling basis throughout January. Finalists are notified on January 27, 2027. Scholars are notified on March 16, 2027. The Stanford degree program(s) communicate admission decisions on their own timelines (as early as December and as late as April), so applicants may receive program admission before or after KHS finalist notification.
